resources.string: Kitten needs the permissions below to read messages and operate apps for you. You stay in control: anything sensitive is sent only after you confirm.
Lets Kitten read the current screen and tap, type, and scroll for you when you ask it to. Sensitive actions such as sending messages always require your confirmation.
Reads the screen and acts on your behalf

The pairing code is only valid while the system pairing dialog is open — switching back to Kitten voids it. So type the code into the notification instead of returning to this page:

1. Tap “Start pairing”. Kitten posts a notification you can type into and jumps to Developer options.
2. Turn on the highlighted “Wireless debugging” → tap “Pair device with pairing code”.
3. When the dialog appears the notification pops up. Tap “Enter pairing code” and type the 6 digits.
4. Keep that dialog open the whole time.
The pairing code goes in a notification — please allow notifications
